title: Translation and Literary Design of Matthew 2:1-12
caption: <bp-cite>Matthew 2:1-12</bp-cite>. Translation and Literary Design by Tim Mackie for BibleProject Classroom: Rise of the Messiah (2024)
usx:
<usx version="2.6">
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="1" /> Now, when <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">Iesous</char> had <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">been</char> born in <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="turquoise">Bethle’em</char> of <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">Ioudaia</char>, 
        </group>
        <group>
          in the days of <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="red">Herodes the king</char>, 
        </group>
        <group>
          look, <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="blue">magi</char> from <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="tan">the eastern regions</char> arrived in <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="black">Hierosoluma</char>, <verse number="2" /> saying, 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="B" type="secondary">
        <group>
          “Where is the one <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">born</char> <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="red">king</char> of the <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">Ioudeans</char>, 
        </group>
        <group>
          because we saw <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="tan">his star in the east</char>, 
        </group>
        <group>
          and <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="violet">we have come to bow down to him</char>.” 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A'" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="3" /> And when <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="red">King Herodes</char> heard, 
        </group>
        <group>
          he was troubled, and all of <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="black">Hierosoluma</char> with him, 
        </group>
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group indent="1" type="secondary">
      <group>
        <verse number="4" /> and having gathered all the chief priests and scribes of the people, 
      </group>
      <group>
        he inquired from them <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="black">where</char> the <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="red">messiah</char> is to be <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">born</char>. 
      </group>
      <optbreak />
      <group>
        <verse number="5" /> And they said to him 
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        “In <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="turquoise">Bethle’em</char> of <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">Ioudaia</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        because that’s how it was written through the prophets, 
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        <verse number="6" /> ‘And you, <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="turquoise">Bethle’em</char> of the land of <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">Iouda</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        you are by no means least among the <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="red">rulers</char> of <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="purple">Iouda</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        because from you will come <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="red">a ruler</char>, 
      </group>
      <group indent="1">
        who will shepherd my people, Israel.’” 
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
  <para>
    <group type="primary">
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="7" /> Then <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="red">Herodes</char>, having privately called <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="blue">the magi</char>, 
        </group>
        <group>
          he learned precisely from them the time of <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="tan">the shining star</char>, 
        </group>
        <group>
          <verse number="8" /> and having sent them to <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="turquoise">Bethle’em</char>, he said, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          “As you go make a careful examination about <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">the child</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          and when you find him, <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="turquoise">report to me</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1">
          so that <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="violet">I too may come and bow down to him</char>.” 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="2" sidebar-value="B" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="9" /> And having listened to <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="red">the king</char> they went, 
        </group>
        <group>
          and look, <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="tan">the star</char> which they saw <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="tan">in the east</char>, 
        </group>
        <group>
          it went ahead of them until going on it stood over the place where <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">the child</char> was, 
        </group>
        <group>
          <verse number="10" /> and seeing <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="tan">the star</char>, they rejoiced with very great joy, 
        </group>
        <group indent="1" sidebar-value="a">
          <verse number="11" /> and coming into <char mark-variant="highlight-dark" mark-color="black">the house</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="2" sidebar-value="b">
          they saw <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="orange">the child</char> with Maria his mother, 
        </group>
        <group indent="3" sidebar-value="c">
          and falling down 
        </group>
        <group indent="4" sidebar-value="d">
          <char mark-variant="text" mark-color="violet">they bowed down to him</char>, 
        </group>
        <group indent="3" sidebar-value="c'">
          and opening up their treasures, 
        </group>
        <group indent="4" sidebar-value="d'">
          they brought to him gifts of gold, frankincense, and myrrh, 
        </group>
      </group>
      <group indent="1" sidebar-value="A'" type="secondary">
        <group>
          <verse number="12" /> and having been warned in a dream <char mark-variant="highlight-light" mark-color="turquoise">not to return</char> to <char mark-variant="highlight" mark-color="red">Herodes</char>, 
        </group>
        <group>
          they departed by another road unto their own country. 
        </group>
      </group>
    </group>
  </para>
</usx>
